rows.observation: Two real exclusive DeleteOnClose handles use checked CloseHandle results in all modes. Opt-in acquisition and release counters retain their opening collector. Failure preserves a body exception with a cleanup note; success output/return follows release.

rows.prospectiveTreatment: Keep API acquisition failure separate from logical probe success. Include unresolved cleanup/finalization in a separately justified enclosing and scratch boundary.
